_doc: The FM-1's measured audio ISR costs (us), the one table tools/cpu_budget.py and tests/py/test_cpu_budget.py predict the whole ISR from. Update it after every device CPU run (tools/hil_cpu.py --worst, 3 runs: the [min, max] of the runs; CC 116's whole-ISR counters): replace a row's values and its src. [M] measured on the FM-1, [E] estimated (how in src).

idle_no_fx.src: [M] hil_cpu idle, no effects (private/TEN-VOICES.md): the ISR entry, the engine's empty block (~85), fx_process's fixed passes

idle_every_fx.src: [M] hil_cpu 'idle, every effect on (heaviest)', the Rhodes at 10 voices, build/batch1 (FM-1 batch 1, 2026-10-24 22:17-22:22, build sonic-d3df27f: the engine merge + OHCD's full range; hil_cpu --worst --usb 48000, every effect, the heaviest drive TYPE (TSH8 by its compiled estimate, CC 84 sent as 81), the delay TAPE): cpu_rhodes_{1,2,3}.log 1164 / 1132 / 1128 us (--bend-sweep 1160; MARIMBA 1148; VIBES 1600, its motor and modes running: in its own worst row). 0.9.4: 1348 (build/crackle/cpu_worst_094.txt)

10.src: [M] hil_cpu --worst --usb 48000 x3 at RH_VOICES 10, build/batch1 (FM-1 batch 1, 2026-10-24 22:17-22:22, build sonic-d3df27f: the engine merge + OHCD's full range; hil_cpu --worst --usb 48000, every effect, the heaviest drive TYPE (TSH8 by its compiled estimate, CC 84 sent as 81), the delay TAPE): app_audio's worst block 3392 / 3284 / 3268 us (run 1: 10 bass v127 + pedal; runs 2 / 3: the slow paths case, 12 notes + pedal), 0 shed, USB clean; --bend-sweep 3376 (cpu_rhodes_bend.log). Not on the device yet (in sonic-int after d3df27f): int-fx (the exact effect rewrites, about -18 us), snd-noise (the key-down knock about +15 us in a bass block, the pedal thud about +10 us in the blocks after a pedal move), whirl-40 (the whirl on keys 40-48: hil_cpu's bass case +25,632 instructions at 10 voices, ~113 us, tests/c/rh_cost.c), SPREAD (0 at SPREAD 0, the default; ~175-240 us at 10 voices when SPREAD > 0). It replaces the 9-voice row (m5 0b8cbff, RH_VOICES 9: app 3832-3892, whole ISR 4136-4204, --bend-sweep 4184; build/v9fm1)

9.src: [M] hil_cpu --engine vibes --worst --usb 48000 at 9 voices, build/batch1 (FM-1 batch 1, 2026-10-24 22:17-22:22, build sonic-d3df27f: the engine merge + OHCD's full range; hil_cpu --worst --usb 48000, every effect, the heaviest drive TYPE (TSH8 by its compiled estimate, CC 84 sent as 81), the delay TAPE), cpu_vibes.log: app_audio's worst block 3564 us (the slow paths case; 9-note chord edge + motor 3288, 9 bass edge + pedal 3324, 9 bass + pedal 3208), 0 shed, cap 48. Before (0.9.4's builds): 3376-3436. Not on the device yet: bars-10 (BAR_VOICES 10, predicted here from this row plus a voice; its savings in est_savings_us bars_10), int-fx, snd-noise

[M] hil_cpu --engine marimba --worst --usb 48000 at 9 voices, build/batch1 (FM-1 batch 1, 2026-10-24 22:17-22:22, build sonic-d3df27f: the engine merge + OHCD's full range; hil_cpu --worst --usb 48000, every effect, the heaviest drive TYPE (TSH8 by its compiled estimate, CC 84 sent as 81), the delay TAPE), cpu_marimba.log: app_audio's worst block 3528 us (the slow paths case; chord / bass edge 3364, 9 bass + pedal 3296), 0 shed. Before (0.9.4's builds): 3412-3544. Not on the device yet: bars-10 (BAR_VOICES 10: from this row plus a voice; est_savings_us bars_10), int-fx, snd-noise

closed.src: [M] the ISR after app_audio, the USB stream closed (private/FX-CPU-STUDY.md section 2, PROF2)

44100.src: [M] the same, the stream open at 44.1 kHz (uac_tap)

48000.src: [M] the same, open at 48 kHz (uac_tap48's 12-tap FIR, ~285 us). Kept at this maximum: build/batch1 (sonic-d3df27f) read 244-256 us in every scenario, but the parts' maxima need not land in one block (VIBES there: app 3564 + tail 256 = 3820 against the whole ISR's 3824), so the lower tail would put the model under a device measurement

bend_us.src: [E] the Rhodes pitch bend's retune, spread (rhodes.c rh_retune: at most a quarter of the voices per block, RH_RT_PER = ceil(9 / 4) = 3 of 9): rh_coef 149 instructions, a voice 5 modes x (33 + 2 x 149) = ~1663 instructions = 7.3 us at 4.4 ns, 3 voices ~22 us, x 1.37 for the 32-bit divides (the FM-1's 55-80 us for the whole 8-voice retune against the 58.5 us count) ~30 us (2 of 8: 15-20 us); 0 while the wheel is held. The unspread retune measured 4440-4500 us whole ISR with hil_cpu --bend-sweep vs 4320-4344 without (2026-10-24). To be measured with --bend-sweep

fx_us._src: [E] per effect ON at its heaviest (private/FX-CPU-STUDY.md section 1, 'ON today'): a breakdown for the scenarios without every effect; their sum plus the fixed passes is scaled to idle_every_fx

rev_type_us._src: each reverb TYPE's cost over HALL in 'every effect' (us; HALL is in the measured rows): [P] the plan's estimate (private plan section 4: PLATE ~150..250 us against HALL's 260, INFINITE +100..170), [E] fx_cost_us (the kernels' REV_US_* from their loop counts; tests/py/test_rev_types.py keeps it in step), [M] hil_cpu --worst with the TYPE (tools/hil_cpu_rev.py)

plate.src: [E] fx_cost_us (feature/rev-plate 466ed0d): REV_US_FRONT 50 + REV_US_DEC 10 + REV_US_PLATE 200 = 260, HALL's FX_US_REVERB; LOW CUT on adds REV_US_LOCUT 16 to every TYPE alike (HALL too)

infinite.src: [E] fx_cost_us (feature/rev-inf 7944ca3, the default LITE tank: REV_US_FRONT 50 + REV_US_DEC 10 + REV_US_INF 369 = 429 = HALL + 169; REV_US_INF set from the FM-1 early check: bright 4248-4280, quarter 4132-4140 us whole ISR)

infinite_bright.src: [E] fx_cost_us with -DREV_INF_QUARTER=0: the LITE tank (the default since 7944ca3; the full bright no longer builds: over REV_US_MAX)

est_costs_us._src: [E] host-estimated costs of 0.9.5 work not yet in the measured rows above: tools/cpu_budget.py adds them to every prediction with the reverb on (the gate stays an upper bound). Remove a row once a device run has measured it (it is then in worst_app / whole_isr)

rev_upsample.src: [E] rev-upsample (the reverb's 2:1 down and 1:2 up as 11-tap half-bands, every TYPE alike): build/frodhes.dis, the return loop 45 -> 70 instructions a half-rate sample (+20 us), the send's clamp +5 a sample (+8), the histories (+5), the pre-delay's loop +3 a sample (+5), the decimator 24 -> 37 a half-rate sample (+11), HALL's matrix +2 (+2): ~51 us a block (rev_types.c REV_US_FRONT 88, REV_US_DEC 23, fx.c FX_US_REVERB 311)

uac_knee.src: [E] 0.9.7 BUGHUNT #38b, the 48 kHz knee (usb.c uac_tap48, 48 kHz only): build/frodhes.dis, the per-output-frame loop 158 -> 187 instructions statically (the knee's slow path 2 x 10, run only above 24576), the common path +2 a channel (one unsigned test) and one more spilled local (stack refs 8 -> 13 in the loop): ~+10 instructions an output frame x 279 frames a block = ~2.8k instructions, ~12 us at 4.4 ns. Counted in every prediction with the reverb on (an upper bound; the 44.1 kHz path is unchanged)

master24.src: [E] 0.9.7 #8, the jack after MASTER at 24 bits (platform.c fm1_alnk0_irq): isr_diff build/frodhes.dis, the MASTER loop with USB VOL following MASTER (the default) +4 instructions a frame (the jack's clamp at 32767 << 8 in place of the shift), 256 frames ~1k instructions, ~5 us; USB VOL FIXED -2 a frame; master_ramp (only while the knob moves) 64 -> 70 instructions; fm1_alnk0_irq 118 -> 130 (3 spills a block)

dither.src: [E] 0.9.7 GitHub #16, the TPDF dither at the cut to Q15 (rhodes.c RH_DITH): isr_diff build/frodhes.dis, rh_q15 10 -> 14 instructions a sample (+1k a block, ~4.5 us), the side's last stage rh_df1_sq 19 -> 31 a sample (+3k, ~13.5 us, SPREAD only), bar_render's cut ~+6 a sample (~7 us, VIBES / MARIMBA): 7 on the bars, 18 on the Rhodes with SPREAD; counted at 18 in every prediction (an upper bound)

est_savings_us._src: [E] host-estimated savings of 0.9.5's CPU work, not yet in the measured rows above (the gate never predicts under a device measurement): information only, tools/cpu_budget.py prints the predictions less them. Remove a row once a device run has measured it (it is then in worst_app / whole_isr). 4.4 ns per instruction (trem_wah's 113 us calibration)

int_fx.src: [E] int-fx (D's exact effect rewrites E1 E3 E4 E5, the tremolo noinline; merged after d3df27f): build/frodhes.dis, every effect on and not limiting about -11 instructions a sample = ~18 us a block (limiting: a further -66 a sample). Remove once the FM-1 batch has measured it. (rh_noteon and tick_keyvel_idle went: build/batch1's d3df27f has them)

bars_10.src: [E] bars-10 (the bar engine's loops out of line in pointer form, byte-identical): build/frodhes.dis counts per sample, 7a3a15b -> bars-10: upper slot Q32 9 -> 7.75, Q30 8 -> 7.5, with the force 13 / 20 -> 10 / 10 (4 samples a turn); the pair 29 / 35 -> 28.5 / 34.5; output + radiation 9 + 8 -> 11 (one pass, the first voice writes: no zero pass); the steal fade + felt noise loop 46 -> fade 10 more than the output + felt 15 (its own pass, felt_n samples only); the pulse 25 -> 16; the levels 107 -> 81 per slot (sat28i). 9 voices x 4.4 ns: a held chord with the motor (6 upper slots, no pulse) ~25,000 instructions a block less (110 us); hil_cpu's repeated chords (9 steals in one block: the fade, the felt noise, the damper's knock on every voice) ~98,000 less (430 us). Remove once the FM-1 batch has measured it

cpu_trim_tape.src: [E] cpu-trim (byte-identical, Gate R): the delay's TAPE loop in two passes (dly_tape.c tp_tape: the tape, the echoes in place in dly_m; tp_loop: the dry's ease and the sum), kf / kh read once a sample: build/frodhes.dis steady path 104 -> 78 + 15 = 93 instructions a sample, stack stores 8 -> 4, loads 17 -> 9: ~2,800 instructions a block, 12 us at 4.4 ns (18 at drive_insns' 1.6 us per instruction a sample). Every engine, the delay on TAPE. Remove once the FM-1 has measured it

cpu_trim_rhodes.src: [E] cpu-trim (byte-identical, Gate R): rh_retune (the pitch bend) computes rh_coef's tuning part once a mode for both decays and takes eps from the voice (DECAY / RELEASE as at its note-on): a mode 2 x (149 + call) -> 58 + 2 x 38 + calls, ~150 instructions and 5 of 8 hardware divides fewer; 3 voices x 5 modes in a bend block: ~2,250 instructions + ~75 divides, 15-17 us, only in the blocks where the bend moves (bend_us 22-30 -> ~7-13). Not counted here (SPREAD 0 only: every voice in rh_pickup): the plain pickup loop two samples a turn, 43 -> 40.5 instructions a voice and sample, ~6,400 a block at 10 voices, ~28 us. Remove once the FM-1 has measured it

whole_isr.src: [M] CC 116's whole-ISR maximum, 10 Rhodes voices + every effect (the heaviest drive TYPE, TAPE), USB open at 48 kHz, build/batch1 (FM-1 batch 1, 2026-10-24 22:17-22:22, build sonic-d3df27f: the engine merge + OHCD's full range; hil_cpu --worst --usb 48000, every effect, the heaviest drive TYPE (TSH8 by its compiled estimate, CC 84 sent as 81), the delay TAPE): hil_cpu --worst x3 3640 / 3528 / 3516 us, 0 shed, USB clean
[M] the same with --bend-sweep (a pitch bend every 5 ms): whole ISR 3628 us, 0 shed (cpu_rhodes_bend.log)
[M] the same, VIBES at 9 voices (edge strikes, motor, every effect): whole ISR 3824 us, 0 shed (cpu_vibes.log)
[M] the same, MARIMBA at 9 voices: whole ISR 3784 us, 0 shed (cpu_marimba.log)
